August 16, 2023 - Dispensing Dynamics International, headquartered in City of Industry, CA, is a premier provider of proprietary plastic injection molded paper towel, tissue, soap, and air care dispensing systems for the “away-from home” washroom industry. DDI is a leading supplier to the world’s largest paper companies including Kimberly-Clark, Georgia Pacific, Wausau Paper, Cascades, Bobrick, SCA Tissue, and other OEM’s and distributors.
